info.title: Japan Places API
info.description:
Derived signals and census aggregates for Japan: municipality census for 1,917 municipalities (2020 census), POI category counts for all 47 prefectures, station catchments, and 13 live signals. Sources: OpenPOI corpus, e-Stat, MLIT, gBizINFO. Free tier with attribution (CC BY 4.0); paid signals via x402 micropayments (USDC on Base) or RapidAPI subscription. Storage, caching, modification, and redistribution are explicitly permitted, unlike Google Places.

Docs: https://koteihi-lab.local-connect-design.trade/RAPIDAPI_DOCS.md

license.name: CC BY 4.0 (free tier) / Commercial License (paid tier)

free.attribution: Source: koteihi-lab Japan Data Foundry, derived from OpenPOI

MEGA.access_note: highest quota; automated SLA and a public status page

x-pricing.table_note: Attribution is required on every response at every tier. The 12 paid datasets are unlocked by the RapidAPI feature "Premium Datasets" (Basic: off, Pro/Ultra/Mega: on). Pay-per-use over x402 is available for all 12 paid datasets. Support is documentation-first and fully self-service: the OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and every error response are the complete reference, and there is no human support. Refunds for RapidAPI subscriptions are handled by RapidAPI support.

rapidapi_subscriptions.note: unused quota is refunded; timing follows the RapidAPI payout cycle

x402_per_call.note: a 402 response is not charged; a settled on-chain USDC transfer is final
